topic: Vegapunk erased his own memory in chapter 1123 because he planned for a traitor
title: Vegapunk Wiped His Own Memory On Purpose
description: Chapter 1123 shows Vegapunk, Shaka and Pythagoras erasing their own memories before Egghead. Here is why that proves how carefully he planned for a traitor. Was it genius or just plot convenience?
comment: Was Vegapunk's memory wipe a stroke of genius, or plot armor for Oda's twist? Pick one.

lines.text: Vegapunk wiped his own memory on purpose, and chapter 1123 proves it.

shot.fallback: three scientists gathered around a snail phone

lines.text: Two days before Egghead falls apart, he records a message with Shaka and Pythagoras.

shot.fallback: three scientists talking over coffee in a lab

lines.text: Shaka is frustrated that Vegapunk wants to wait so long before revealing anything.

shot.fallback: annoyed scientist at a recording snail

lines.text: Then all three erase their memories, so none of the other satellites notice a thing.
Most people missed it: Vegapunk trusted only two satellites without question.
Those are the two he wiped. He feared what a traitor could pull out of them.
He was right. In chapter 1078, York admits she wanted to become a Celestial Dragon.

shot.fallback: woman scientist confessing to her creator

lines.text: He had traced the leak to her two weeks earlier.
Some call the wipe a plot trick. But they reread their message stunned, so the wipe was real.

shot.fallback: scientists reading a message with shocked faces

lines.text: That's a scientist who planned for betrayal inside his own head.
So who was all that secrecy really protecting, and who was his last quiet message for?

shot.fallback: scientist and a blond cook in a lab

lines.text: Two days before Egghead fell apart, here is what he did...

shot.fallback: scientist alone facing a recording snail
